title: Karnataka Launches Tathyakosh Public Data Portal

blocks.content: Karnataka launched the public data portal Tathyakosh.in in Bengaluru on 12 August 2026. The portal was developed by the ACSEL Technology Forum, a Karnataka government Centre of Excellence in artificial intelligence, in collaboration with the IIT Alumni Centre Bengaluru. It was introduced as an open, non-commercial digital public good.

items: ACSEL Technology Forum is a Karnataka government Centre of Excellence in artificial intelligence.
IIT Alumni Centre Bengaluru partnered in the development of Tathyakosh.in.
The portal is described as an open, non-commercial digital public good.
“Tathya” and “Kosh” are Sanskrit words used in the portal’s name.
